title: Defuse the projectStore barrel expected-exports merge hotspot
goal: PROBLEM: api/projectStore.barrel.test.js guards the public re-export surface with a hand-maintained alphabetical expectedTypes map. Whenever two concurrent tasks each add an export to api/projectStore.js, both append adjacent lines to the same map, guaranteeing a git merge conflict plus a test update on every such collision, and each collision costs a merge-failure -> resolver -> re-review loop. ACCEPTANCE: (1) two concurrent export additions merge without a conflict region (or are auto-resolved with a green test); (2) the barrel still fails if a re-export is dropped, wrapped, or copied instead of referenced.
